    Subcategories determined by indecomposable representatives #

    For an indecomposable skeleton σ of FGModuleCat R, a subcategory (in the sense of Statement.Subcategory) is determined by the set of indecomposable representatives it contains. The subcategory generated by a set S of representatives is add S (addOf, the objects admitting a presentation as a finite direct sum of representatives in S), and C ↦ ind C (indOf) and S ↦ add S are inverse bijections (indOf_addOf, addOf_indOf).

    Under this correspondence the quotient and submodule closures of σ are ind Gen(add S) and ind Cogen(add S) (mem_qSet_iff, mem_sSet_iff), the operators (4.2) of the manuscript.

    Retract closure of add S (inAdd_of_retract) is the Krull–Schmidt input: an indecomposable retract of a direct sum of representatives is one of them.
